title: Synthesis of Novel Schiff Base and Azetidinone Derivatives and their Antibacterial Activity
abstract: A series of Compound 4‐(2᾽‐hydroxy‐3᾽‐chloro‐5᾽‐ethyl phen‐1᾽‐yl)‐1‐(4᾽‐tolyl)‐3‐chloro‐2‐azetidinone 4a‐j have been prepared by the reaction of 2 ‐hydroxy‐3 ‐chloro‐5 ‐ethyl‐N‐(p‐tolyl)‐chalconimines 3a‐j with chloroacetyl chloride in the presence of triethylamine. The Schiff base derivatives 3a‐j has been prepared by the condensation of different substituted chalone derivatives 1 with p‐toluidine 2. The synthesized compounds were screened for their antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli.
